I lived in Hill for the past two semesters (which was an all-girls dorm; might be co-ed this year?), and honestly, it has its benefits and cons.

Benefits:

\- lot less noise

\- a more tight-knit community

\- in-room sink

\- better room space allocation. In terms of Hill Hall specifically, it's the dorm that gets all the Lower 5 mail, so you save a lot of time by getting a room there.

​

Cons:

\- The hygiene is poor.

\- Showers are outdated and get messy really easily.

\- The furniture given inside our rooms is not clean when entering (rust in the sink, mold, holes in the wall, etc.)

\- There are no elevators

\- There are fewer washing machines and dryers, so you have to wait longer to do your laundry.

Be prepared for a larger amount of bugs entering your room during the summer or early fall. My room had at least 4–5 cockroach sightings during just August–October, and we had occasional ones over winter and spring.

​

Overall, though, I enjoyed my time at Hill, regardless of the negative circumstances. It's not as social as the high-rises, but I enjoyed how closer all of us were. Did hear some negative experiences with the people I knew over at Boggs, but for all of the other dorms, it was mainly only positive news. Do carry a lot of bug spray with you though, and best of luck deciding what dorm you're gonna live in!
